runtime_defects.before: Moving a muted visual clip left anchored dialogue/ducking at the old position in warm cache.
runtime_defects.fix: Cache keys include resolved audio-event start and source probes.
runtime_defects.after: Agent warm/cold decoded amplitudes identical; formal regression decodes actual audio.

runtime_defects.fix: Carry current locks into restored content before validation/commit.
runtime_defects.after: Agent and CLI regression retain locks.

runtime_defects.fix: Validate a unique list of existing clip IDs before committing.

runtime_defects.before: Crossfade length compared against cumulative prior end, allowing an overrun of a short preceding clip.
runtime_defects.fix: Check prior clip length and preceding overlap.

integration_fixes: Update shared startup authority to five options and generic video QA/handoff tables to FrameCut editing ownership.
Record/read scoped review evidence separately from technical verification.
Permit only half-source-tick quantization residual when checking word cuts.
environment_observation: Scratch synchronization replayed transient file states in ordinary scratch test folders. Tests rerun under node_modules stopped the anomaly; preserved sources and locks were verified there. Not represented as a product bug.
scope: No continuous playback or subjective audio listening claimed by test agents; frame inspections and decoded audio/timing/loudness checks are explicit.
